parameters.help: How far the pitch drops or rises when the tone wheel brake is used.

parameters.name: Percussion level, normal
parameters.help: 0 to 127. The menu shows this as -22.0 to +10.5 dB; the steps in between are not published.

parameters.name: Percussion level, soft

parameters.name: Percussion decay time, slow
parameters.help: Higher is a slower decay. Cont holds the percussion as long as the key is held.
parameters.notes: The MIDI table gives 00-18 (0 - 24); the menu shows 1 to 24 and Cont (p. 85), the same 25 values. This app shows the menu's names.

parameters.name: Percussion decay time, fast

parameters.notes: The MIDI table gives 00-18 (0 - 24); the menu shows 1 to 24 and Cont (p. 85), the same 25 values. This app shows the menu's names.

parameters.name: Leslie horn mic level
parameters.notes: The manual gives a length of 02 but writes the data as single bytes (00, 01-4D). This app sends two bytes, as the length column says.

parameters.name: Leslie horn mic width
parameters.notes: The MIDI table says 00-64 (0 - 100 cm); the menu says 0 to 40 cm or Side (p. 121). They don't agree, so this app shows the raw number, 0 to 100.

parameters.name: Leslie horn mic distance
parameters.notes: Raw 00 1E to 01 48 (30 to 200). The table says 0-170 cm for the horn but 30-200 cm for the drum; the menu (p. 121) says 0 to 170 cm for both, which is how it is shown here.

parameters.name: Leslie drum mic level
parameters.notes: The manual gives a length of 02 but writes the data as single bytes (00, 01-4D). This app sends two bytes, as the length column says.

parameters.name: Leslie drum mic width
parameters.notes: The MIDI table says 00-64 (0 - 100 cm); the menu says 0 to 40 cm or Side (p. 121). They don't agree, so this app shows the raw number, 0 to 100.

parameters.name: Leslie drum mic distance
parameters.notes: Raw 00 1E to 01 48 (30 to 200). The table says 0-170 cm for the horn but 30-200 cm for the drum; the menu (p. 121) says 0 to 170 cm for both, which is how it is shown here.

parameters.name: Organ sounding point
parameters.notes: The MIDI table says Patch, 1-7, Velocity, nine names for eight values (00-07). The menu (p. 137) says Patch, 1-6, Velocity, which fits.

parameters.name: Preset key hold time
parameters.help: How long a Preset Key must be held to recall a patch.
parameters.notes: The MIDI table says 00-0A (0.0 - 1.0 sec); the menu says 0 to 100 ms (p. 137). This app follows the menu, in 10 ms steps. The organ's display will settle which is right.

parameters.name: Individual parameters
parameters.help: How the organ sends and receives single setting changes. SysEx lets this app hear every setting.

parameters.name: Patch load
parameters.help: Instant loads a patch as soon as you turn VALUE; Entered waits for ENTER.
